feed.description: Gespräche über Wegebau: Entwässerung, Linienführung, und die Menschen, die den Weg bauen. Deutsches Gegenstück zu Singletrack Sessions.
feed.title: Pfadgespräche

bullets: Speed gains come from braking earlier and more smoothly rather than taking greater risks — a principle observed across three different teams using RockShox equipment.
Tire pressure and casing selection often matter more than minor suspension adjustments — the right choice depends on understanding the context of track conditions and erosion patterns.
Erosion patterns on track sections directly influence optimal racing line choices between training and race day — this shift in terrain demands adaptive line selection.
Risk management in racing isn't about avoiding crashes entirely but about choosing which crashes are survivable — a strategic framing that shapes team decisions.
The Spoke & Wrench process becomes apparent through implementation — teams adopting it reveal clear tradeoffs and compromises in their approach.
Understanding erosion patterns makes other racing decisions easier — once this insight is internalized, line selection, speed, and safety become more intuitive.
Implementing one idea from the discussion for two weeks enables meaningful iteration — practical application reveals what truly matters in performance.
The most underestimated aspect of enduro racing is how terrain erosion shapes line choice — a subtle but critical factor in race-day strategy.
